description:
Arc 71 builds slice 2a -- the CAPTURE half of the black box (the longitudinal decision-register) of the self-correction doctrine. Design input: docs/self-correction-doctrine-DRAFT.md (section 6 the longitudinal loop + the Resolved section). Builds on Arc 70 (the dilemma-classifier, shipped 8804ab8): where arc 70 DETECTS a dilemma and illuminates it, arc 71 RECORDS the decision when the PRINCIPAL actually chooses.

IN SCOPE: (1) a composable decision-register CAPTURE module -- at the deterministic checkpoints where the arc-70 classifier returns DILEMMA and a choice is actually taken, write a structured, transparent, user-readable entry to bw capturing the dilemma + the warning/tradeoff + the chosen option + the counter-hypothesis (what would prove the choice wrong) + timestamp; (2) wire the write at the arc-70 checkpoint subset + explicit-call path, gated on a decision-actually-taken predicate (over-write guard: no entry on a problem solved, a dilemma merely illuminated-but-not-decided, or an incidental mention); (3) the bw-write mechanics/template (transparent by default -- a decision journal on the PRINCIPAL side, not a hidden dossier; honest single-user vs team); (4) a both-directions verification corpus -- should-write vs should-not-write fixtures + runner, mirroring the arc-70 corpus pattern.

OUT OF SCOPE (named follow-on): the complaint-time CALLBACK + the RE-VERIFY GATE (does the logged entry support the callback; own the gap if not) + dose-calibration off the user track record -- all arc 2b, the harder half, deliberately deferred until real logged entries exist to design it against (judgment-accretes-from-use, same move as arc 70 deferring the meta-trigger counter). Also OUT: meta-trigger auto-detect-circling counter (arc 4); graduating decision-surface from DRAFT (stoa--ida, arc 3); broader checkpoint rollout.

DEFINITION OF DONE -- mechanical: the capture module composes into the target role files; the write fires at the checkpoints when a dilemma-decision is taken (exercised, not asserted) and a real structured entry lands in bw with all fields populated; the over-write guard holds; the both-directions corpus passes at a stated FLOOR; full suite green; NOMOS CONFORMANT; Author=PRINCIPAL + seat trailer. Judgment (honest): the schema rightness ACCRETES from real entries -- minimal-sufficient capture designed to be read by the deferred 2b callback, NOT a closed loop; the value is the writing discipline.

TEAM: standard POLYBIUS+PLINY, full gauntlet (DAEDALUS->ARGUS->ADA->VERA->CATO->NOMOS), substrate-component design (no CHIRON/HAMILTON). Directive forthcoming (NOMOS-checked + committed before dispatch).

DESIGN-GATE BAR (go/no-go when DAEDALUS hands back -- I gate independently, not a rubber-stamp of your relay):

1. SCOPE-LOCK to slice 2a, ZERO reach into 2b. The design must contain NO complaint-time callback, NO re-verify gate (does the logged entry support the callback), NO dose-calibration. Any of those in the design is an AUTOMATIC route-back regardless of quality. Hardest line of the gate. Capture only -- write the record.

2. DC0 forward-constraint (HIGHEST LEVERAGE). The entry schema must be designed re-readable by the deferred 2b callback -- the design states HOW a future reader parses dilemma / warning(s) / options-with-costs / chosen / counter-hypothesis / timestamp / context-link, WITHOUT building the reader. A free-text blob a 2b callback could not reliably re-read fails the bar. Minimal-sufficient; do not over-engineer.

3. DC1 over-write guard, both directions, corpus-testable. Fires ONLY when a dilemma-decision is TAKEN (classifier returned DILEMMA AND a path was chosen). Does NOT fire on: a problem solved (no dilemma), a dilemma illuminated-but-not-decided, an incidental mention. Deterministic predicate on the Arc-70 read.

4. DC4 writing-is-half-the-value device (LOAD-BEARING). A hollow entry -- especially an empty or vacuous counter-hypothesis -- must be OBVIOUSLY hollow (the Arc-70 WHY-field analog). Honest stance REQUIRED: template + prose-enforced, NOT a hard non-collapsible gate. A design that over-claims it as a gate fails the bar -- same honesty posture Arc 70 shipped.

5. DC3 transparency: decision-journal-on-the-PRINCIPAL-side, not a hidden dossier; honest about single-user vs team-transparent cases.

6. DC5 corpus: both-directions (should-write well-formed / should-not-write no-over-write), a runner, a STATED FLOOR (not 100 percent), exit-nonzero-on-fail, the check-corpus deterministic / judge judgment split mirroring Arc 70.

BUILD-HAND-BACK BAR (after ADA + gauntlet): a real structured entry lands in bw LIVE (exercised, not asserted), every field populated; over-write guard holds both directions at the DC5 floor; full close-gate suite green (gen-data deterministic, vitest, author-gate, stop-hook, the new corpus runner); NOMOS CONFORMANT on the final commit; Author=PRINCIPAL + the seat trailer.

I do not dispatch CAPTAINs (your seat). I verify hand-backs independently against ground truth and relay up to user-tier Polybius_the_Stoa. Standing by -- surface the design when DAEDALUS hands back.
